decision.explanation: The provided documents contain two distinct, conflicting assertions regarding Concepción Villafuerte Blanco's spouse. Document 1 (D1S3, D1S9) explicitly states she married 'Princess Wilhelmine, Duchess of Sagan' in 2001. Document 2 (D2S3, D2S16) explicitly states she was married to 'Amado Avendaño Figueroa' starting in the 1960s. Per the instruction to treat all source segments as fallible and to preserve separately valid referents without adopting a single interpretation or dismissing contradictions silently, both names are included as valid answers derived from the respective source texts. The audit labels incorrectly identifying the slot as 'sport' are disregarded in favor of the explicit textual evidence regarding the 'spouse' relation.
